commit fe9374cdaf62e91af8ab2ee4cfb3e726b7e22d56
Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Fri Mar 7 15:59:03 2025 -0800
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Fri Mar 7 15:59:03 2025 -0800

    Bug 783526 - remove NS_ERROR_NNTP_NO_CROSS_POSTING. r=babolivier
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D240434

diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/messengercompose/composeMsgs.properties b/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/messengercompose/composeMsgs.properties
index d2866e2553b..9583a703e9e 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/messengercompose/composeMsgs.properties
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/messengercompose/composeMsgs.properties
@@ -36,7 +36,6 @@ unableToSendLater=Sorry, we were unable to save your message for sending later.
 dontShowAlert=THIS IS JUST A PLACEHOLDER.  YOU SHOULD NEVER SEE THIS STRING.
 
 failedCopyOperation=The message was sent successfully, but could not be copied to your Sent folder.
-nntpNoCrossPosting=You can only send a message to one news server at a time.
 msgCancelling=Cancelling…
 sendFailedButNntpOk=Your message has been posted to the newsgroup but has not been sent to the other recipient.
 errorReadingFile=Error reading file.
diff --git a/mailnews/base/public/msgCore.h b/mailnews/base/public/msgCore.h
index c16b37e98fd..efabad7c0ce 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/public/msgCore.h
+++ b/mailnews/base/public/msgCore.h
@@ -180,9 +180,7 @@ class nsIMsgFolder;
    12500 and 12999 are reserved.
 */
 #define NS_MSGCOMP_ERROR_BEGIN 12500
-/* NS_ERROR_NNTP_NO_CROSS_POSTING lives here, and not in
- * nsMsgComposeStringBundle.h, because it is used in news and compose. */
-#define NS_ERROR_NNTP_NO_CROSS_POSTING NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(12554)
+
 #define NS_MSGCOMP_ERROR_END 12999
 
 #if defined(XP_WIN)
diff --git a/mailnews/compose/src/MimeMessageUtils.sys.mjs b/mailnews/compose/src/MimeMessageUtils.sys.mjs
index 4c155970941..57b0f254024 100644
--- a/mailnews/compose/src/MimeMessageUtils.sys.mjs
+++ b/mailnews/compose/src/MimeMessageUtils.sys.mjs
@@ -47,8 +47,6 @@ export var MsgUtils = {
   NS_MSG_UNABLE_TO_SEND_LATER: generateNSError(12525),
   NS_ERROR_BUT_DONT_SHOW_ALERT: generateNSError(12527),
 
-  // 12554 is taken by NS_ERROR_NNTP_NO_CROSS_POSTING.  use 12555 as the next one
-
   // For message sending report
   NS_MSG_ERROR_READING_FILE: generateNSError(12563),
 
@@ -879,7 +877,6 @@ export var MsgUtils = {
       [this.NS_ERROR_SMTP_SERVER_ERROR]: "smtpServerError",
       [this.NS_MSG_UNABLE_TO_SEND_LATER]: "unableToSendLater",
       [this.NS_ERROR_BUT_DONT_SHOW_ALERT]: "dontShowAlert",
-      [this.NS_ERROR_NNTP_NO_CROSS_POSTING]: "nntpNoCrossPosting",
       [this.NS_MSG_ERROR_READING_FILE]: "errorReadingFile",
       [this.NS_MSG_ERROR_ATTACHING_FILE]: "errorAttachingFile",
       [this.NS_ERROR_SMTP_GREETING]: "incorrectSmtpGreeting",
diff --git a/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.cpp b/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.cpp
index 6e121bf4b3a..4b274efc8c8 100644
--- a/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.cpp
@@ -35,8 +35,6 @@ const char* errorStringNameForErrorCode(nsresult aCode) {
       return "unableToSendLater";
     case NS_ERROR_BUT_DONT_SHOW_ALERT:
       return "dontShowAlert";
-    case NS_ERROR_NNTP_NO_CROSS_POSTING:
-      return "nntpNoCrossPosting";
     case NS_MSG_ERROR_READING_FILE:
       return "errorReadingFile";
     case NS_MSG_ERROR_ATTACHING_FILE:
diff --git a/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.h b/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.h
index 990866a3a23..56b58af568e 100644
--- a/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.h
+++ b/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.h
@@ -27,8 +27,6 @@
 #define NS_ERROR_BUT_DONT_SHOW_ALERT                NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(12527)
 #define NS_ERROR_MIME_MPART_ATTACHMENT_ERROR        NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(12531)
 
-/* 12554 is taken by NS_ERROR_NNTP_NO_CROSS_POSTING.  use 12555 as the next one */
-
 // For message sending report
 #define NS_MSG_ERROR_READING_FILE                   NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(12563)
